blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: The tree is the booklet
blocks.body:
**DITA Maps Manager** is the booklet view. The folder list (Project view) is just files on disk.

A page can sit on disk and still be missing from the booklet. That is like a chapter printed and left in a drawer.

**Root map** :  the booklet Oxygen should use as the main table of contents. Set it. Later, names defined in the booklet will work.

blocks.title: DITA Maps Manager View in Oxygen XML Editor 19
watchFor: Root map control on the toolbar

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You only opened the map as tags, or you cannot say tree vs folder list.

Expected: Maps Manager shows the sample booklet. Root map is set. Two-line note saved.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Switch to the DITA perspective if you have it, so Maps Manager docks on the side.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Open flowers.ditamap in Maps Manager (the tree), not only as tags.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Set this map as the root map. The control is on the toolbar :  if the label differs, write the label you see.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: In oxygen-bootcamp-work/week3/day-16-views.txt write two lines: Maps Manager = the booklet. Project view = the files on disk.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not add a page yet.

blocks.summary: Maps Manager shows the sample booklet. Root map is set. Two-line note saved.

options: The booklet (what the reader will follow)
Every file on your whole computer
blocks.why: The tree is publication structure. The folder list is files on disk. They are not the same.

options: So names defined in the booklet can resolve on the pages
So Oxygen can delete unused files
blocks.why: The sample booklet already defines a product name. Without a root map, that name may not show.
